_comment: Generated by tools/make_idrive_tweaks.py - edit there, not here. Known reversible G30/NBT EVO coding changes, applied by the owner in BimmerCode. BMW Link never writes coding. Availability depends on the car; BimmerCode is the source of truth. Head-unit software mods (themes, extra apps) are out of scope - see docs/idrive-customization.md.

tweaks.title: Apple CarPlay full-screen
tweaks.what: Makes CarPlay fill the whole iDrive screen instead of leaving BMW's side band of widgets.
tweaks.why: CarPlay maps and apps get the full display, which is easier to read while driving.
tweaks.how: BimmerCode -> Head unit (HU) -> look for “Apple CarPlay” / “CarPlay fullscreen” and turn it on.
tweaks.undo: Set it back to the factory value (the split view).
tweaks.needs: Apple CarPlay already active on the car (your car has wireless CarPlay).

tweaks.title: Keep CarPlay from expiring
tweaks.what: Removes the time limit some cars put on the CarPlay enablement so it stays on for good.
tweaks.why: CarPlay keeps working without a renewal or a dealer visit.
tweaks.how: BimmerCode -> Head unit (HU): the CarPlay/feature-enablement option. On many G30s CarPlay is already permanent; check first.
tweaks.caveat: Only relevant if your CarPlay was ever shown as time-limited. Yours already works, so this may not apply.

tweaks.title: Digital speed in the Head-Up Display
tweaks.what: Adds a digital km/h or mph number to the colour Head-Up Display.
tweaks.why: A clear speed readout in your line of sight.
tweaks.how: BimmerCode -> Instrument cluster (KOMBI) -> HUD content -> enable the digital speed field.
tweaks.undo: Remove the field in the same place.
tweaks.needs: The factory Head-Up Display (your car has it).

tweaks.title: Digital speed in the cluster
tweaks.what: Adds a digital speed number to the instrument cluster.
tweaks.why: An exact speed without reading the analogue needle.
tweaks.how: BimmerCode -> Instrument cluster (KOMBI) -> the digital-speed option.

tweaks.title: Extra consumption & efficiency views
tweaks.what: Unlocks extra trip and efficiency readouts in the cluster and iDrive.
tweaks.why: More detail on how the car is driving and using fuel.
tweaks.how: BimmerCode -> Instrument cluster (KOMBI) / Head unit (HU): the consumption/statistics options.

tweaks.title: More content in the Head-Up Display
tweaks.what: Shows extra items in the HUD such as the speed-limit sign, entertainment and phone info.
tweaks.why: More at-a-glance information without looking down.
tweaks.how: BimmerCode -> Instrument cluster (KOMBI) -> HUD content -> enable the fields you want.
tweaks.undo: Turn the individual fields back off.
tweaks.caveat: A busy HUD can be distracting; add fields one at a time and keep what helps.

tweaks.title: Sport displays (gauges on iDrive)
tweaks.what: Turns on BMW's own performance pages: a digital power and torque gauge, plus consumption, on the iDrive screen.
tweaks.why: This is the factory way to get real gauges on the iDrive screen — no head-unit modification needed.
tweaks.how: BimmerCode -> Head unit (HU) -> “Sport displays” / “M Sport displays” -> on. Then on the car: Menu -> your vehicle -> the Sport/performance view.
tweaks.needs: NBT EVO (you have it). The look is BMW's; it isn't a custom gauge you design.

tweaks.title: Play video from USB
tweaks.what: Enables playing video files from a USB stick through iDrive.
tweaks.why: Watch your own media without extra hardware.
tweaks.how: BimmerCode -> Head unit (HU): the USB/media video option, where present.
tweaks.caveat: Same as video in motion: passenger use only while driving.

tweaks.title: Video in motion
tweaks.what: Lets the screen play video (and CarPlay video apps) while the car is moving, instead of only when parked.
tweaks.why: A passenger can watch video on a drive.
tweaks.how: BimmerCode -> Head unit (HU) -> “Video in motion” / “VIM” -> on.
tweaks.caveat: For passenger use. Watching video while driving is unsafe and illegal in most places — don't use it in the driver's view while moving.

tweaks.title: Faster screen wake
tweaks.what: Tweaks a start-up delay so the screen and map come up sooner after the car is unlocked.
tweaks.why: Less waiting for iDrive after you get in.
tweaks.how: BimmerCode -> Head unit (HU): the quick-start / standby options, where present.
tweaks.caveat: Keeping the head unit more awake can draw a little more power when parked; fine with regular driving.

tweaks.title: Navigation map in the HUD
tweaks.what: Shows a small navigation map or richer turn arrows in the Head-Up Display.
tweaks.why: Follow directions without glancing at the centre screen.
tweaks.how: BimmerCode -> Instrument cluster (KOMBI) -> HUD content -> navigation.
tweaks.undo: Turn the navigation HUD content back off.
tweaks.needs: Factory navigation and the Head-Up Display (your car has both).

tweaks.title: Second phone / full Bluetooth
tweaks.what: Enables pairing a second phone at once and the fuller Bluetooth office/streaming features.
tweaks.why: Two phones connected, and more phone features in iDrive.
tweaks.how: BimmerCode -> Head unit (HU) -> the telephony / Bluetooth feature options.

tweaks.title: Automatic door locking
tweaks.what: Locks the doors automatically as you drive off, and/or unlocks when you park or take the key out.
tweaks.why: Convenience and a bit of security, set to your taste.
tweaks.how: BimmerCode -> Body (BDC) -> the auto-lock / auto-unlock options.
tweaks.undo: Set them back to the factory behaviour.

tweaks.title: Fold mirrors when locking
tweaks.what: Folds the door mirrors in when you lock the car and unfolds them when you unlock it.
tweaks.why: Tidier parking and a little protection in tight spots.
tweaks.how: BimmerCode -> Body (BDC) -> the mirror fold-on-lock option.

tweaks.title: Skip the “I agree” start-up screen
tweaks.what: Stops iDrive from showing the legal warning you have to confirm every time the car starts.
tweaks.why: iDrive goes straight to the map or your last screen.
tweaks.how: BimmerCode -> Head unit (HU) -> “Disclaimer” / “Legal disclaimer” -> disable.

tweaks.title: Windows from the key / comfort access
tweaks.what: Lets you open or close the windows (and sunroof) by holding the key button or the door handle.
tweaks.why: Air the car out before you get in on a hot day.
tweaks.how: BimmerCode -> Body (BDC) -> the remote window / comfort-opening options.

tweaks.title: Cluster style / lighting
tweaks.what: Switches between the cluster's built-in looks (e.g. the Sport red/black style) where the car offers them.
tweaks.why: A dashboard look you prefer.
tweaks.how: BimmerCode -> Instrument cluster (KOMBI) -> the cluster style / background option.
tweaks.needs: The cluster must have more than one built-in style.

tweaks.title: Start-up animation
tweaks.what: Changes the welcome animation shown on the cluster and screen at start-up (e.g. a sportier set).
tweaks.why: A nicer greeting that matches your car.
tweaks.how: BimmerCode -> Instrument cluster (KOMBI) / Head unit (HU) -> the start-up / welcome animation option.
tweaks.caveat: This picks between BMW's built-in animations. A fully custom animation needs head-unit modification (out of scope).

tweaks.title: Hide screens you don't use
tweaks.what: Lets you turn off iDrive menu tiles and tabs you never open, where the coding allows.
tweaks.why: A cleaner iDrive with only what you use.
tweaks.how: BimmerCode -> Head unit (HU): the menu / main-menu visibility options, where present.
tweaks.caveat: How much can be hidden varies by software version.

tweaks.title: More favourite buttons
tweaks.what: Unlocks extra programmable favourite buttons for iDrive functions, where supported.
tweaks.why: One-press access to the screens you use most.
tweaks.how: BimmerCode -> Head unit (HU): the favourites / programmable-button options.
tweaks.undo: Set the count back to standard.
